incidents.title: Multi-Vehicle Collision on Mirpur Road
incidents.description: A severe multi-vehicle pile-up occurred during evening rush hour near the Dhanmondi 27 intersection. Three buses and multiple rickshaws were involved, causing significant injuries to 12 commuters and blocking traffic for over 4 hours. Poor road lighting and absence of lane markings were cited as contributing factors.

incidents.title: Pedestrian Hit-and-Run near Sadarghat
incidents.description: A pedestrian was struck by a speeding vehicle near the Sadarghat ferry terminal area late at night. The victim sustained moderate injuries. Witnesses reported the area has minimal street lighting and no pedestrian crossings, making it a recurring danger zone for foot traffic.
